Kalpanagar Municipal Corporation
Circular 14/2026 · Monsoon preparedness · 2 June 2026

1. Drains and garbage
From 10 June, ward teams will clear
roadside
drains
every
Monday.
Residents must not throw garbage into
drains; the fine is ₹500 for each
offence. Wet waste collection continues
every day between 7 and 10 am.
Report a blocked drain on the NMC
citizen portal. The ward engineer will
inspect it within two working days.

2. Water supply
During heavy rain, water supply in lowlying wards may be cut for up to six
hours to protect the pumps. Tankers
will be sent to affected wards on
request.
Boil drinking water from June to
September. Free chlorine tablets are
available at every ward office.
